title: GDD T-109 — ScoreModel: estrellas bonus con exclusión + apuesta final (§6.2/§6.3) [gate Hito 2]
description: Extend the existing ScoreModel (TASK-003 era) with the GDD §6 systems. Payouts stay data-driven (default [6,4,2,1] competitive; coop 4 win / 1 fail — the absolute-zero payout is banned, §6.1). FINAL_WAGER (§6.2): each player compulsorily bets 25/50/75% of coins (stick choice, 5 s timeout -> default), pot redistributed by final-microgame result at 50/30/15/5%. Bonus stars (§6.3): at Game Over, 2 stars drawn (session seed) from the hidden-objective pool tracked by in-session counters — Kamikaze (most eliminations), Cangreja (most weapons used), Zen, Gatillo (best REACCIONA latency), Inversora (most invested), Fantasma (least robbed); each worth 1 star. Acotación rule: the draw EXCLUDES combinations that would hand victory to a player trailing by >= 3 stars (absurd-but-justifiable comebacks only). Final tiebreak chain: estrellas -> monedas -> microgame wins -> declared shared podium. Catch-up stays bounded per §6.2 (rubber-band and head-start live in mechanics; wager compression is the ScoreModel's lever, max ~1 star of swing). This closes Hito 2 at Core level. Read GDD §6 fully before coding.
acceptance_criteria: Payout tables are data (GameTuning-style), validator-compatible, and never emit a zero payout for any place in any mode
FINAL_WAGER: compulsory 25/50/75 choice with 5 s timeout default; pot math exact at 50/30/15/5; property test shows wager compresses coin distribution and can swing at most about 1 star of value

Bonus stars: all six counters tracked; seeded draw of 2; exclusion rule provably prevents any draw that would flip victory to a player >= 3 stars behind (exhaustive test over constructed scenarios plus 1000-seed fuzz)
Tiebreak chain estrellas -> monedas -> victorias -> declared tie implemented and tested including the full-tie shared-podium case
Determinism: same session seed + same counters -> same stars (replay test)
Tests-first; fast suite green after, no regression; existing ScoreModel consumers keep compiling

comments.author: developer-cloud
comments.body: [developer-cloud] TASK-037 delivered on branch claude/gdd-hito1-cloud, tests-first. 04b6aaa test(core): failing spec (red = CS0246/CS0234 on Barcade.Core.Scoring, 18 tests covering all 6 ACs); 3037b02 test helper-arity syntax fix; 0f0d662 test envelope correction (see below); 26d974f feat(core). Suite 492 -> 512 green, zero regressions. DESIGN CALLS for reviewer + human, all [ASSUMED]-tagged in code: (1) ZEN STAR: the GDD 6.3 table row is TRUNCATED AT THE SOURCE ('| Estrella Zen | Menor |') — direction (min) survived, metric name lost. Implemented as a generic min-direction counter (RecordZenMetric) so gameplay supplies the semantic; HUMAN MUST fill in the metric (likely 'menor movimiento/input') and fix the GDD. (2) Wager timeout default = Half (50%) — GDD names none. (3) Star ties -> no holder (-1) — GDD silent on ties. (4) Wager rounding: stakes floor; tied places pool the percentages of spanned positions and split; <4 active players renormalize so the whole pot always redistributes (5.3 no-vanishing invariant); remainders dealt bottom-up. (5) Exclusion rule: at fixed 1-star bonus values a >=3-star flip is STRUCTURALLY IMPOSSIBLE (2 bonus stars close at most 2) — noted §5.6 agrees ('voltear 1 estrella — nunca uno de 3'); implemented as a parameterized defensive filter (threshold arg), proven live by a threshold=2 test, plus 1000-seed fuzz pinning the invariant end-to-end; 2-star flips via coin tiebreak remain allowed (GDD bans only >=3). (6) v1 ScoreModel untouched (new Barcade.Core.Scoring namespace) — same coexistence rationale as v2 IMicrogame; ticket says 'extend' but v1's win/loss shape shares nothing with coins/stars/wager. (7) Test-data fix 0f0d662: my original swing-test envelope wrongly used income (35) as simultaneous holdings for all four players; corrected to the §5.6 post-sink envelope — assertion semantics unchanged, flagged for reviewer audit. (8) GDD internal inconsistency noted: §5.6 says '2-3 de bonificación final' while §6.3 says exactly 2 bonus stars — implemented §6.3 (operative spec). (9) Draw uses SeededRandom.Derive(seed, 0, RngStream.Draws) from TASK-044 — one decision, one tirada.
